description: This PHP source file defines the BuzzPostAPI class, which provides REST endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and managing social media posts (text, photos, videos) within the OrangeHRM system's Buzz plugin. It handles request validation, post creation, editing, validation rules, and references external classes/models for Post, Photo, Video, and Share entities.

classes.name: BuzzPostAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints for CRUD operations on Buzz Posts, including creating posts with text, photos, or videos, retrieving posts by ID, and updating existing posts. It integrates with the underlying data layer and manages validation rules and transaction handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new Buzz post, supporting text, photo, or video posts. Begins a transaction, validates input, persists post data, and returns the created post object.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Buzz post by ID, optionally returning a detailed model based on query parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Buzz post identified by ID, handling validation, photo deletion, media updates, and saving changes within a transaction.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for creating a post, tailored based on whether the post is text, photo, or video type.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for updating an existing post, including optional deletion of photos and media type changes.

methods.name: setBuzzPost
methods.description: Sets the basic post info like text and employee details on a BuzzPost entity.

methods.name: setBuzzShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with a BuzzPost and employee details.

methods.name: setBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Processes and saves base64-encoded photo attachments to a BuzzPost, with validation on number and size.

methods.name: setBuzzVideoPost
methods.description: Creates and associates a BuzzLink (video URL) with a BuzzPost, after validating the URL.

methods.name: getPhotoValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for photo attachments, including size, format, and count constraints.

methods.name: getVideoValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for video URL links.

methods.name: getTextValidationRuleForOtherPost
methods.description: Validation rule for optional post text for non-text posts.

methods.name: getTextValidationRuleForTextPost
methods.description: Validation rule for required post text in text-only posts.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; placeholder for delete operation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; placeholder for delete validation rules.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines which response model class to use based on request parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzFeedPost
methods.description: Retrieves a detailed BuzzFeedPost object for a given post ID, including related share info.

methods.name: updateBuzzVideoPost
methods.description: Updates or creates a BuzzLink with the new video URL link.
